newsitem.title: USA: Oppenheimer has 9.1 pct of Silcorp.
newsitem.headline: Oppenheimer has 9.1 pct of Silcorp.

text.p: Investment house Oppenheimer & Co Inc said on Monday it had acquired for itself and accounts managed by it a total of 377,800 common shares of Silcorp Ltd, or 9.1 percent of the total number outstanding.
It said that since a takeover bid by Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc for Silcorp was announced, it had acquired for itself and accounts managed by it a total of 179,900 Silcorp shares or 4.3 percent.
Couche-Tard, which owns a chain of convenience stores in Quebec, on August 26 launched a C$16.50 a share bid for Silcorp, which also owns convenience stores, mainly in Ontario.
